properties.description:

properties.areaDesc: Citrus, FL; Levy, FL; Marion, FL
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 17 at 9:29PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

Withlacoochee At US 41 Dunnellon affecting Marion, Levy and Citrus
Counties.

.The Withlacoochee River at Dunnellon has been steadily rising since
July, and on September 15 reached flood stage.  The cause of the high
water along the Withlacoochee River at Dunnellon is due to excessive
hydrilla growth (from the river bottom to the water surface) along a
4.5 mile stretch of river between US 41 and Lake Rousseau.  The
hydrilla is acting like a dam and holding water back, causing water
levels to rise.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Withlacoochee at US 41 Dunnellon.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 28.2 feet, Docks and boat ramps flood along the river
in Citrus and Marion counties.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:45 PM EDT Thursday the stage was 28.2 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 28.2 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:45 PM EDT Thursday was 28.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady above flood
stage at 28.2 feet.
- Flood stage is 28.2 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 28.3
feet on 10/05/1965.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Friday afternoon at noon EDT.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 17 at 8:52PM MDT until September 17 at 9:45PM MDT by NWS North Platte NE
properties.description:
SVRLBF

The National Weather Service in North Platte has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northwestern Arthur County in west central Nebraska...
Southwestern Grant County in west central Nebraska...
Northeastern Garden County in the Panhandle of Nebraska...

* Until 945 PM MDT.

* At 852 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 9 miles east of
Crescent Lake National Wildlife Refuge, or 23 miles north of
Oshkosh, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Swede Lake, Deer Lake, Adams Flats, Britton Lake, and Rackett.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

To report severe weather, contact your nearest law enforcement
agency. They will send your report to the National Weather Service
office in North Platte.

Heavy rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to flash
flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 17 at 9:32PM MDT until September 17 at 10:15PM MDT by NWS Pocatello ID
properties.description:
SVRPIH

The National Weather Service in Pocatello has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
West central Bingham County in southeastern Idaho...

* Until 1015 PM MDT.

* At 932 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Pingree, or
15 miles west of Blackfoot, moving northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect
wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Blackfoot, Moreland, Rose, Pingree, Rockford, and Groveland.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Large hail, damaging wind, and continuous cloud to ground lightning
are occurring with this storm. Move indoors immediately. Lightning is
one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder,
you are close enough to be struck by lightning.
